sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: National University of Health Sciences vs Walden University (NationalU vs Walden) reveals distinct differences in ownership, size, and location. National University of Health Sciences is a private nonprofit institution located in Lombard, with an undergraduate enrollment of 13 students. In contrast, Walden University is a private for-profit university based in Minneapolis, enrolling 9,136 undergraduates. Tuition information is available for Walden University, with an in-state tuition of $12,762, while National University of Health Sciences does not report in-state tuition. These factors highlight the contrasting profiles of NationalU vs Walden in terms of institutional type, student body size, and geographic setting.
